D: Passengers fight to survive a zombie outbreak on a high-speed train from Seoul to Busan.
P: Serve the snacks as the train pulls out of Seoul station.
S: the snack you grab before the train leaves

Seaweed rolls of sesame rice packed with egg ribbon, pickled radish, carrot, spinach and bulgogi beef, sliced into rounds and brushed with sesame oil. Cook 400g short grain rice and season with 1 tbsp sesame oil and salt. Fry 200g thinly sliced beef with 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sugar. Cook 3 beaten eggs into a thin omelette and slice into strips. Blanch 200g spinach, squeeze and season with sesame oil. Julienne 1 carrot and quickly fry. Spread rice over 5 nori sheets, lay the fillings and strips of yellow pickled radish across, roll tightly, brush with sesame oil and slice.
Double fried wings in a sticky gochujang and soy glaze

Wings coated in potato starch, fried at 160C for 8 minutes, rested, fried again at 190C, tossed in gochujang, soy, honey and garlic glaze with sesame seeds. Toss 1kg chicken wings in 100g potato starch. Fry at 160C for 8 minutes, rest 5, then fry at 190C until very crisp. Simmer 2 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp soy, 3 tbsp honey and 2 crushed garlic cloves until glossy. Toss and scatter with sesame seeds.
Chewy rice cakes simmered in a gochujang sauce (tteokbokki)
Cylinder rice cakes soaked 20 minutes, simmered in anchovy stock with gochujang, gochugaru, sugar and fish cake until glossy and thick, spring onion over the top.
M: Busan dwaeji gukbap pork and rice soup
dwaeji gukbap, the dish Busan is known for

Milky pork bone broth with tender sliced pork, ladled over rice with spring onion, chilli paste and garlic chives, kimchi and salted prawns on the side. Blanch 1.5kg pork bones in boiling water for 10 minutes, drain and rinse. Cover with 3L fresh water, add 1 onion, 6 garlic cloves and a knob of ginger, and boil hard for 3 hours, topping up, until milky. Add 600g pork belly for the last 60 minutes, then slice. Strain the broth and season. Pour over bowls of cooked rice with the pork, spring onion and chives. Serve with kimchi and gochujang.
KTX to Busan kimchi fried rice
Bacon and kimchi fried with cold rice

Cold rice fried in a smoking pan with chopped aged kimchi and its juice, bacon, gochujang and butter, pressed to crisp on the bottom, topped with a fried egg and nori. Fry 150g chopped bacon until crisp, then add 300g chopped kimchi and a splash of its juice. Add 4 cups cold cooked rice from 300g jasmine rice, 1 tbsp gochujang and 30g butter, and press flat to crisp the bottom. Top each bowl with a fried egg and torn nori.
W: Yeast pancakes filled with brown sugar, cinnamon and peanuts

Sweet yeasted dough rested an hour, filled with brown sugar, cinnamon and chopped peanuts, pressed flat in an oiled pan and fried until the sugar melts inside. Mix 300g flour, 7g yeast, 1 tbsp sugar and 220ml warm water and rest an hour. Mix 80g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 40g chopped peanuts. Fill 8 balls of dough with the mix, seal and press flat in an oiled pan. Fry until golden and the sugar melts inside.
K: Banana, milk and honey blended and strained smooth, no alcohol
Ripe banana blended with cold full cream milk, a little honey and a pinch of salt, strained and served very cold.
